rapport_notes: Adaptive and warm — pivoted smoothly when a proposed virtual walkthrough wasn't possible, handled an extra in-home furniture-moving request graciously.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "Is there any specific concern or what are you most worried about..." — asked only after full inventory, box count, and parking details were already collected
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer said "I don't want anything damaged of course but... nothing really I'm too concerned about" — a real, if thin, concern that got a brief acknowledgment ('Sure.') with no follow-up question or damage-coverage reassurance
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "you're not bound by the numbers if you're able to take a hard load or disassemble the beds in advance... preparation... the last time the move will take, more money you will save... does it sound fair" — hits window, self-prep, beats-it, and fairness-check lines together

top_strength: Adapted smoothly when the customer couldn't do a virtual walkthrough — pivoted straight to a thorough phone-based inventory and still delivered a fully personalized, range-based estimate with four of five Save Your Ass lines, then closed and booked the move on the same call.
coaching_note: When the customer said he didn't want anything damaged, that was the exact moment to name the $2,000 damage-coverage guarantee — instead it got a one-word acknowledgment and no follow-up, missing a free trust-building opportunity.
